name: Witch Doctor: Slither stops attacks and casts, and can be cancelled (#6019)
contract: Slither 500947's tooltip: 'Transform into a serpent ... You cannot attack or cast spells'. Its effects are SPELL_AURA_MOD_INCREASE_SPEED (31), SPELL_AURA_TRANSFORM (56, creature 2914) and SPELL_AURA_MOD_PACIFY_SILENCE (60), which sets UNIT_FLAG_PACIFIED and UNIT_FLAG_SILENCED. #4092 and its reopening #6019 report the opposite in game: attacks and casts go through, and the buff cannot be cancelled. Cause: SpellMgr::LoadSpellInfoCustomAttributes marks effect 2 negative (SpellInfo::_IsPositiveEffect returns false for aura 60), and only afterwards the OnLoadSpellCustomAttr hook in AscensionWitchDoctorCompletion removed that effect. The aura lost its pacify and silence but kept SPELL_ATTR0_CU_NEGATIVE_EFF2, so SpellInfo::IsPositive is false and WorldSession::HandleCancelAuraOpcode refuses CMSG_CANCEL_AURA. Shadow Bolt 686 (PreventionType silence) is the probe cast: accepted before Slither, refused with SPELL_FAILED_SILENCED (104) during it. Melee is probed with melee_attack_count, which counts swings including misses, so a zero count during Slither means no swing was attempted; the same attack after the cancel must swing again, which shows the pacify, not range or facing, stopped it. The probe cast waits out the 1.5 s global cooldown Slither starts, and every Slither check finishes inside its 5 s duration.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Control: Shadow Bolt is accepted without Slither
Let the Shadow Bolt cast finish
Wait out the global cooldown Slither started
A level-60 swing timer fires within 2 s
Slither refuses attacks: no melee swing
Let the swing timer run again
Control: after the cancel the same attack swings
